summary: Masahiro Inami specializes in Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy. He studied at Hiroshima University from around 1984 to 1990 and held a post at Tokyo Gakugei University from around 1995 to 2005.

Masahiro Kusunoki was a scholar of religious and Buddhist studies who studied at Tohoku University from around 1948 to 1953. He served as a professor of religious studies and history of religion at Tohoku University from around 1970 to 1985.

Masahiro Shimoda is an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo and the University of Delhi. He was a professor at the University of Tokyo from 1994 to 2023 and became a professor at Musashino University in 2023.
Masahiro Takano works in the fields of Indology and Buddhist studies. He pursued doctoral studies at Taisho University, where he was attested as a librarian in 1995.

Masakazu Tanaka studied at Tohoku University, London School of Economics, and the University of London. He was an assistant professor at Kyoto University from 1988 to 2019 and became vice president and professor at the Professional Institute of International Fashion in 2019.

Masako Keta, a scholar of philosophy and religious studies, studied at Kyoto University under Yoshinori Takeuchi. She served as an associate professor and professor at Kanazawa University before serving as professor of philosophy of religion at Kyoto University from 2000 to 2018.
Masamichi Asukai worked in Japanology, history, and archaeology. He studied at Kyoto University from around 1954 to 1958 and held a post there from around 1976 to 1998.

Masamichi Ichigo is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Otani University, Kyoto University, and in the US under Susumu Yamaguchi, Yuichi Kajiyama, and Gadjin M. Nagao. He held professorships at Kyoto Sangyo University, Otani University, and Kyoto Koka Women's University.

Masamichi Sakai specializes in Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology. He earned his doctorate at the University of Vienna under doctoral supervisor Helmut Krasser and was attested as an associate professor at Kansai University in 2015.

Masanori Nakagawa is a scholar of Buddhist studies who held posts at Chikushi Jogakuen University, where he was attested as a lecturer in 1991 and as an associate professor of the Faculty of Letters in 2002.

Masanori Shono works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. He held posts as an assistant professor at Osaka University, attested in 2012, and as a researcher at the University of Munich, attested in 2015.

Masao Abe was a philosopher and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Kyoto University, Union Theological Seminary, and Columbia University. He was a professor of philosophy at Nara University of Education from 1952 to 1980 and taught at Kyoto University and University of Hawaiʻi.

Masao Shizutani was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and history/archaeology. He held assistant professor posts at Josai University and Tokyo University of Foreign Studies, the latter attested in 1974.

Masao Yamaguchi was a religious studies scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo and Tokyo Metropolitan University. He served as a professor and director at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies and later became president of Sapporo University in 1999.

Masaru Akimoto is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He held an appointment at Kyoto Women's University, where he was attested as a professor in the Faculty of Contemporary Society in 2002 and attested in 2015.

Masashi Nagai is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed his studies and doctorate at Komazawa University. He served Komazawa University as a lecturer, associate professor, professor emeritus in 2017, and university president in 2019.
Masataka Suzuki works in religious studies and related fields. He studied at Keio University from around 1968 to 1972 and later held a post there from around 1989 to 2015.
Masataro Sawayanagi studied at the University of Tokyo from around 1885 to 1888. He held posts at Tokyo University of Education, Tohoku University, Kyushu University, and Taisho University.

Masato Kobayashi specializes in linguistics and Indology. He studied at Kyoto University and completed his PhD at the University of Pennsylvania under George Cardona, later serving as a research fellow at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies from around 2001 to 2006.

Masatoshi Konishi was an Indology and history scholar who studied at International Christian University, University of Calcutta, University of Tokyo, and Rikkyo University. He was an associate professor at Hosei University and later professor emeritus at Rikkyo University.
